seed.description: The good customer to find more of: {name, domain?}. The domain is how the skill tells the seed apart from same-named companies.

why_good_customer.description: The seller's own words on why the seed is a good customer: what they bought, why, what made the deal fast or large, what they do with it.

constraints.description: Hard limits for every lookalike, e.g. 'North America only, no agencies, under 1,000 employees'. They become must_have or exclusion rubric criteria.

max_queries.description: The most search queries to return, firmographic ones included.

firmographic_queries.description: How many of the queries may be plain industry or size searches, labelled firmographic. The rest are led by behavior, pain or timing.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Dates timing traits and stamps report.meta. Without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions; never guessed.
